_comment: THE USER'S BOARD (EDF seed 9 gi=8 T4, 2026-09-10): 'we simply do not get the Combo Off button
in enough cases. Once I have the combo assembled for infinite mana and a draw source, blue or
black and a colourless source it should be clear that I can win with the combo.'
Emiel + Cloud of Faeries is the loop; Dimensional Infiltrator ({1}{C}: opponent exiles their top
card) is the kill; Mariposa Military Base is the ONLY {C} source and it is TAPPED. Cloud untaps
up to TWO lands, and by raw yield the top two are Kitchen (1 + two Overgrowths = 5) and the
Conservatory (1 + Wild Growth = 2) -- Mariposa (1) never comes back, so the loop banks mana it
can never convert into a {C} pip and the deck-out fires zero times.
Before MTG_UNTAP_C_STARVED this board offered NO button, and it was right not to: forced past
the projection with MTG_COMBO_OFF_PROJECT=0 the trial apply ran the whole go-off and did not
win. The defect was upstream, in WHICH lands the untap picks. With the starved promotion the
untap reserves one slot for Mariposa (refund 6 instead of 7, and one colourless a pass), the
recognizer models the same set, FlickerGoOffCount sizes the count by the PIPS as well as the
mana, and the finish is real -- which combo_off_verify re-derives by applying the plan.
